text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It was on the way back from an outing. 
Just as I was talking with Curren Chan and 
heading toward the school store—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there's a whole mountain of 
cardboard boxes! It stretches all the way 
over there—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wait, that's...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. I did ask around among people I know, 
but with this much quantity, it's still 
tough...

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... I'm sorry, Fuji-chan. I ended up 
troubling you with my problems too..."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, no, not at all. If anything, I wish I 
could have been more helpful...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm. I see, I see~

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, I figured it was a great chance to 
get closer with everyone☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to barge in out of nowhere! I was 
just wondering... if maybe you were having 
some trouble~.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, you guys are...

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
My! Fuji-chan. As expected of a dorm 
leader, you're quite popular~.

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Well, the lady made a mistake 
with the order quantity, you see.

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
We only planned for 100 instant ramen 
cups, ...but 100 dozen ended up arriving.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even if we return them, it's not like 
they'll come pick them up right away. 
Besides, storing this much is... well, 
yeah.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, true. If we have this many cardboard 
boxes, they'll fill up the whole school 
store.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...In other words, if everything sells 
out, maybe everyone will be happy?
choice_data_list: Can't we help with Curren's UmaSta?
I'll try to do something about it!
I'll figure something out! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...In other words, if everything sells 
out, maybe everyone will be happy?
choice_data_list: Can't we help with Curren's UmaSta?
I'll try to do something about it!
I'll figure something out! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, we help each other out when in 
trouble! Besides...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming a crisis together makes you 
even closer friends, after all☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...No need for fancy decorations, I guess. 
Just stack these instant noodles into a 
pyramid and done.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Should I post the photo on Umatter too 
this time, not just on Umastagram?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yup, decided! The hashtag is—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Right this way! This is the venue for 
#TracenBonds #Help #CupNoodleFest♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Chatter, chatter... Buzz, buzz...*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur... Buzz, buzz...)

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
That's amazing, Curren-chan! Everything 
might sell out completely soon!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~♪ Was Curren able to help out?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's more than enough of an achievement! 
You really are amazing, Curren!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So this is what it means to master social 
media. I'd heard the rumors, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Madam President? What are you doing 
here?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I heard that like a rising dragon riding 
the clouds, a single Umamusume stirred up 
a storm of excitement at the school store 
with her tremendous effort. I thought I'd 
come observe a little.

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh my goodness! Even the Chairwoman! Here, 
please have the very last cup of ramen!

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, Curren-chan's power truly is 
something incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, is that so~? Curren is super happy 
too~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Curren Chan brilliantly resolved 
the store commotion. ...By the way, her 
social media follower count went up even 
more.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wah, Big Brother! You're so dependable~!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wah, Big Sister! You're so dependable~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after asking my fellow Trainers, I 
managed to get a few of them to agree to 
buy some cup ramen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, they agreed to reach out to people 
they know as well—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing! So many people are coming to 
buy from us? That's my Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing! So many people are coming to 
buy from us? That's my Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, thank you so much. I'm so glad I was 
able to talk with you all!"
choice_data_list: Shall we think about how to sell it next?

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
That's true. For Trainers, it's about time 
for work to end.

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
"If that's the case, I'll also have to 
apply for night hours. And call someone to 
help with the register—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Um, I'd like to help out too!

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Huh, but don't you have a curfew? Besides, 
horse girls need to rest their bodies.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No! If you're going to work hard, Big 
Brother, then Curren will too...! Please!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No! If you're going to work hard, Big 
Sister, then Curren will too...! Please!

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text: My goodness...!
choice_data_list: Be back by curfew, you hear?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Okaaay♪ I got ittt♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up selling cup ramen 
alongside Curren Chan—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Here you go~. Thanks for always taking 
care of Big Bro~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Here you go~. Thanks for always taking 
care of Big Sis~♪

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you! You have such a lovely 
smile~!

text_block_list.name: PR Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! We'd like the check here too, 
please!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if it's fine after that, I'd like to 
ask for one as well.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —Wait, Madam President!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, the farrier I work with reached out 
to me, you see. Could I get three... no, 
four of them?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay♪ Hehe, adult connections sure are 
amazing~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They managed to safely sell out all of the 
instant ramen cups. A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"The girl you're training is such a 
wonderful kid! If you ever need someone to 
run alongside her, just let me know 
anytime!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Passionate love calls from fellow 
Trainers kept flooding my phone, one after 
another. Was this part of her calculations 
too...?
